modalLead: Two fixes for a row's More menu: it no longer opens behind the row below it, or behind the header pinned to the top of the list.

items.text: A row's More menu no longer opens behind the row below it. Under a theme with depth, the menu appeared cut in half — the row underneath painted straight over it. It now opens above its neighbours, and the row's actions stay visible instead of fading out from under the pointer.
An open menu now clears the header pinned to the top of the list. Near the top of a long list the menu slid underneath it; the same applies to the bar that appears when you tick rows.
